nodes.label: Universe CSV
nodes.description: /universe/universe.csv (id, text, date, label) + lexicon.json. About 20,000 rows, about 18,000 of them unlabelled.

nodes.label: Practice gold forms
nodes.description: data/practice.csv with its gold forms, baked into the image as trusted facts.

nodes.label: Extractor
nodes.description: Subject gazetteer (lexicon names and aliases), value regexes (value-forms.md), a TF-IDF + logistic regression attribute classifier, and same-page coreference (He / Its / The platform).

nodes.label: Temporal KB
nodes.description: A timeline per subject and attribute, with support votes across the universe and a trust score per page. lookup(subject, attr, date) gives the value in force on that date.

nodes.label: CfC liquid net
nodes.description: Optional (USE_NEURO=1): a closed-form continuous-time network that scores whether a value is still current. Fed in as one more feature.

nodes.label: Truth classifier
nodes.description: Features (agrees with or contradicts the value in force, support, page trust, value kind) go into LightGBM, then isotonic calibration maps confidence to 0.5–1.0.

nodes.label: ~18,000 labels
nodes.description: true / false / unsure per unlabelled row; confidence 0.5–1.0, empty for unsure.

nodes.label: Claim generator
nodes.description: Templates from claim-forms.md: fact, compare, change, at_event and relation, built only from values the KB firmly supports.

nodes.label: Validator
nodes.description: Checks entry.schema.json, lexicon names, the claim-forms rules and novelty (not a copy of an input row). An invalid claim is sent back to be regenerated.

nodes.label: Writer
nodes.description: Writes a temp file in /output, then os.replace() to output.csv. A fallback table goes down early, and a watchdog writes again at the deadline.

nodes.label: output.csv
nodes.description: /output/output.csv: id, type, text, form, label, confidence. The labels plus exactly 1,000 new claims.
